$Comment: Grabs and drives that carry a foe along. A foe wearing the game's Immune is never taken; the stun that holds it while it is carried counts as a Stun. A boss or an elite is never carried, an ability's own grab included, unless a rule of its own says otherwise. Retune it on the Control Kinds screen (/zigadmin), or in mods/ziggfreedcommon/control-kinds.json under Carry.
Description: A grab or a drive that carries the foe
